platform_info.name: LinkedIn
platform_info.description: Handles DDPs in English. These data donation flows have not been tested yet, if you find anything wrong with them report to datadonation@uu.nl and they will be fixed!

description.en: Advertisements you clicked on while using LinkedIn. These show what professional opportunities and products caught your eye.
description.nl: Advertenties waarop u heeft geklikt tijdens het gebruik van LinkedIn. Deze laten zien welke professionele kansen en producten uw aandacht trokken.

documentation.summary: Each row represents one advertisement the participant clicked on LinkedIn.

columns.Ad clicked Date: Date on which the ad was clicked.
columns.Ad Title/Id: Title or numeric ID of the clicked advertisement.

description.en: Comments you posted on LinkedIn. These reflect how you engage in professional discussions.
description.nl: Reacties die u op LinkedIn heeft geplaatst. Deze weerspiegelen hoe u deelneemt aan professionele discussies.

documentation.summary: Each row represents one comment the participant posted on LinkedIn content.

description.en: Companies you follow on LinkedIn. This reflects the industries and organizations you're interested in.
description.nl: Bedrijven die u volgt op LinkedIn. Dit weerspiegelt de sectoren en organisaties waarin u geïnteresseerd bent.

documentation.summary: Each row represents one company the participant follows on LinkedIn.

columns.Followed On: Date on which the participant started following the company.

title.nl: Berichten die je hebt gedeeld op LinkedIn

description.en: Content you shared with your professional network on LinkedIn.
description.nl: Content die u heeft gedeeld met uw professionele netwerk op LinkedIn.

documentation.summary: Each row represents one post the participant shared on LinkedIn.

columns.SharedUrl: URL of the content that was shared.
columns.MediaUrl: URL of any media attached to the share.
columns.Visibility: Visibility setting of the share (e.g. PUBLIC, CONNECTIONS).

description.en: Your reactions to posts and content on LinkedIn. This reveals what professional content resonates with you.
description.nl: Uw reacties op berichten en content op LinkedIn. Dit onthult welke professionele content bij u aanslaat.

title.en: The type of reactions you put under posts on LinkedIn
title.nl: De soorten reacties die je plaatst onder berichten op LinkedIn

documentation.summary: Each row represents one reaction the participant gave to a post or content on LinkedIn.

columns.Type: Type of reaction (e.g. Like, Celebrate, Support).

description.en: Your professional connections on LinkedIn. This network represents your professional relationships over time.
description.nl: Uw professionele connecties op LinkedIn. Dit netwerk vertegenwoordigt uw professionele relaties in de loop van de tijd.

documentation.summary: Each row represents one first-degree LinkedIn connection of the participant.

columns.Email Address: Email address of the connection, if shared.
columns.Position: Current job title of the connection.
columns.Connected On: Date on which the connection was established.

description.en: What you searched for on LinkedIn. This reveals your professional interests, job searches, and networking patterns.
description.nl: Wat u op LinkedIn heeft gezocht. Dit onthult uw professionele interesses, zoekgedrag naar banen en netwerkpatronen.

title.en: What you searched for on LinkedIn
title.nl: Waar je naar hebt gezocht op LinkedIn

documentation.summary: Each row represents one search query the participant performed on LinkedIn.

columns.Time: Timestamp of when the search was performed.
columns.Search Query: The search term entered by the participant.

description.en: List of LinkedIn members you are following
description.nl: Lijst van LinkedIn-leden die je volgt

documentation.summary: Each row represents one LinkedIn member the participant follows.

columns.To: Name or identifier of the followed member.
columns.To Name: Display name of the followed member.
